**Instructions for Use:**
1. Copy this template to a new file named after the role (e.g., `technical-lead-myproject.md`)
2. Fill in all bracketed placeholders with project-specific information
3. Remove any sections that are not applicable
4. Keep this document updated as the role evolves during the project
